pages.text: Since 1.3.0 there is a way to get aluminium $(item)without electricity$(), so you are never stuck before your first generator.$(br2)$(l)The recipe$()$(br)In a Create $(item)Mechanical Mixer$() over a $(item)Basin$():$(br2)$(li)4 $(item)Bauxite Powder$()$(li)1 $(item)Coal Coke Dust$()

give $(item)1 Aluminum Ingot$(). The basin must be $(item)superheated$(): put a Blaze Burner under it and feed the blaze a $(item)Blaze Cake$().$(br2)$(l)Coal Coke Dust$()$(br)Crush $(item)Coal Coke$() in Crushing Wheels: one coke gives one dust. Coal coke comes from the coke oven, covered in the steel chapters.

$(l)When to stop$()$(br)This recipe is meant to start you off. Electrolysis turns the same 4 powder into an ingot plus extra nuggets and needs no coke dust, so once your first generators are running, move your bauxite to a vat.
